caption_zh:
【AI 虛擬角色】本影片由 AI 生成的虛擬角色「步驟」說明，畫面中的角色為 AI 生成，並非真人；螢幕錄影由工作室真人操作。資料日期：{YYYY/MM/DD}。
錄製條件：{工具}｜{價格頁區域與語言}｜{YYYY/MM/DD}　由工作室真人操作錄製
資料來源：{價格頁名稱}（{YYYY/MM/DD}）{網址}
看價格頁，先看 3 個欄位：
1. 幣別：標價用什麼貨幣
2. 計費週期：月繳或年繳；年繳價有沒有換算成每月
3. 稅金說明：含稅、未稅，或頁面沒寫
本片只整理頁面寫了什麼，不比較方案，也不判斷哪個方案值得。價格與條件可能已變動，請以官方頁面當天顯示為準。
本頻道與影片中提到的工具廠商無隸屬或合作關係。
#訂閱 #AI工具 #價格頁
caption_gloss_en:
[AI virtual character] This video is explained by the AI-generated virtual character "Buzhou"; the character on screen is AI-generated and is not a real person; the screen recording is operated by a real person at the studio. Data date: {date}.
Recording conditions: {tool} | {price-page region and language} | {date}  operated and recorded by a real person at the studio
Sources: {price page name} ({date}) {URL}
Reading a price page: look at 3 fields first:
1. Currency: which currency the price is in
2. Billing period: monthly or yearly; whether the yearly price has been converted to a monthly figure
3. Tax statement: included, excluded, or the page does not say
This video only organises what the page says; it does not compare plans or judge which plan is worth it. Prices and terms may have changed; go by what the official page shows that day.
This channel has no affiliation or partnership with the tool vendors mentioned in the video.
#訂閱 #AI工具 #價格頁

sources.claim: The public pricing page of the example tool: currency and amount as the page shows them for the plan zoomed on, the billing period (and whether the yearly price is converted to a monthly figure), and the tax statement or 「這頁沒寫」, on the date and time seen. The operator pastes the page URL, the date and time seen, and the region and language of the page. Whether Taiwan prices include tax is unverified: say only what the page says. No conversion, no promotion banner in any zoom.
NO FACTUAL CLAIM: the three fields (currency, billing period, tax statement) are the studio's own reading method.
